subject: The story behind OnYourSite & We are hiring! 👋
body:
The OnYourSite Story

Hey {full_name},

Have you ever wondered how OnYourSite started? We were tired of slow, bloated website builders that charge you for every little feature. We wanted a place where anyone could claim a premium piece of the modern web — instantly, securely, and beautifully.

We are expanding our team! 🚀

As our platform and community grow, so does our need for passionate people. We are currently looking for new team members! If you are into web development, UI/UX design, or community management, we would love to have you on board.


The best way to get in touch with us is through our official Discord server. Let's build the future of personal profiles together.

Join our Discord
